data.action: 趴在池边，湿发贴着肩颈
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.description: 私人风吕热气蒸腾的石砌池边，艾雅法拉整个人趴在光滑的池石上，湿漉漉的卷发紧贴着纤弱白皙的肩颈，羊耳因水温而泛着红晕。她微红着脸回头看你——「前辈……水温好舒服。能麻烦前辈帮我把背上够不到的地方轻轻揉一揉吗？」
data.promptProse: She rests both forearms on the pool edge and looks back, wet curls lying against her neck. Her bath wrap rests at the waterline; moonlight catches the nearby stone and rising steam.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 私汤
data.animaCaption: Both forearms rest on the pool edge; her bath wrap stays at the waterline.
